items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: I remember the song he used to sing, the Mark Corina and everything.

ctx.x: What year would that be, Ben?
That was around, that was in, stuff like stuff

24 and 25. Yeah, because he played with, after this fellow Joe Wynn left and my cousin left where he was Chinese. That's where Chinese met Sid and everything, piano player. And he was, all of us was stiff. And I remember the song he used to sing, the Mark Corina and everything. Yeah. He could sing that.
